_doc: After-checks: copy to $KREW_HOME/restart-window-after.json. units: unit -> {name, why, cmd, env, timeout_s, once}. Run once a unit the window restarted came back OK; each posts one RESULT line on the window's card. once = only the first window that restarts the unit. None by default.

_reference_install.left_out: its one row (a one-off check of a dev-box voice fix, with the owner's dated note and a dev-box path)
